responses.answer: Based on the available financial documents, NVIDIA Corporation reported total revenue of $60.9 billion for fiscal year 2024, representing a 126% increase from the prior year [1]. This remarkable growth was primarily driven by the Data Center segment, which generated $47.5 billion in revenue, a 217% increase from the previous year [1]. The surge in data center revenue reflects strong demand for NVIDIA's AI computing platforms and GPUs used in machine learning and artificial intelligence applications.
